assumptions: Finite connected unweighted complete multipartite simple graphs with at least two nonempty parts, counting measure, real vertex functions modulo constants, unnormalized combinatorial heat semigroup.
limitations: No conclusions for normalized Laplacians, arbitrary weighted graphs, or other spatial norms. Historical priority remains subject to unindexed explicit semigroup and transport calculations.
scientific_integrity: The star case is an earlier known special case and not claimed independently as new. Universal statements proved analytically; exact-rational finite computations corroborate but cannot certify every real parameter. No independent audit has been performed.
title: Largest-part universality for graph heat-flow Lipschitz norms
